semipermanente.descrizioneBreve: Bright, flawless colour that lasts up to three weeks.
semipermanente.descrizione: Semi-permanent polish combines the convenience of nail polish with the hold of gel: full colour, day-one shine and no smudging for at least three weeks. The application is millimetre-precise, with the cuticle always left clear and the edge sealed to prevent lifting.
semipermanente.perChi: Perfect for anyone with little time for their nails who still wants colour that always looks neat, and for anyone who works a lot with their hands.

fasi.testo: Gentle buffing and dehydration: the foundation of any long-lasting hold.
Rubber base applied thinly and levelled to even out any irregularities.
Two thin coats, each cured separately, for full colour without bulk.
Glossy top coat and free-edge sealing to prevent lifting.

aftercare: Wait at least 12 hours before soaking your hands in hot water
Do not use your nails as a tool: it is the number one cause of lifting

faq.domanda: Does semi-permanent polish damage the nail?
faq.risposta: No, when it is applied and removed correctly. Damage almost always comes from over-filing during preparation or from peeling it off.

faq.domanda: How often should it be redone?
faq.risposta: About every 3 weeks. Beyond 4 weeks the regrowth levers on the edge and the risk of lifting increases.

ricostruzione-gel.descrizioneBreve: Structure, strength and a made-to-measure shape, built by hand.
ricostruzione-gel.descrizione: A full set builds the nail where there isn't one: length, apex and curve are shaped by hand to achieve a harmonious form and, above all, a structure that holds. The result is strong but thin, natural to the touch and in weight.
ricostruzione-gel.perChi: For anyone with fragile nails that break before they grow, for anyone who wants length, and for anyone who wants a shape their natural nail would not allow.

fasi.testo: Reading the nail plate, basic shaping and surface preparation.
Gel applied on a form or dual form, with the apex built at the point of greatest stress.
Refining the profile, the curve and the thickness: this is what decides how long it lasts.
Colour, nail art if you want it, sealing and cuticle oil.

aftercare: Come back for a refill within 3–4 weeks: don't wait for lifting
If a nail breaks, don't pull it: book an appointment
Cuticle oil every day, on the enhancement too

faq.domanda: How long does a full set last?
faq.risposta: The structure holds for months; what changes is the regrowth. That is why we do a refill every 3–4 weeks instead of starting over.

faq.domanda: Can I go back to natural nails whenever I want?
faq.risposta: Yes. Removal is done in the studio, filing down the thickness and leaving a protective veil that thins out as the nail grows.

refill.descrizioneBreve: The maintenance that keeps the set perfect over time.
refill.descrizione: A refill fills the regrowth area and rebalances the structure, moving the apex back to the right place as the nail grows. Done regularly, it is what means you never have to rebuild the set from scratch.
refill.perChi: For anyone who already has a full set or a gel overlay and wants to keep it neat, healthy and correctly structured.

fasi.testo: Checking for lifting and the state of the nail plate under the gel.
Thinning the old gel and preparing the new area.
New gel in the regrowth area and the apex moved back into the right position.
Profile filing, colour and final sealing.

aftercare: Keep to the 3–4 week rhythm: that is the key to everything
Tell us straight away about any discomfort or lifting

faq.domanda: Can I have a refill on work done elsewhere?
faq.risposta: Yes, after an assessment. If the previous structure cannot be saved, we suggest removal and a new full set.

faq.domanda: How many times can it be repeated?
faq.risposta: Indefinitely, as long as the natural nail underneath stays healthy. We check it at every appointment.

treccine.descrizioneBreve: Braids done in the studio, by appointment.
treccine.descrizione: We do braids by appointment. Size, number and length are agreed together before we start, along with the time needed: the quote is set during the consultation, before the work begins.
treccine.perChi: For anyone who wants well-made braids and likes to agree on style and size together before starting.

fasi.testo: We decide together the size, number and length of the braids, and how long the work will take.
Washing and detangling, then dividing the hair into neat sections to work on.
The braids are made one by one, with controlled tension so the roots are not stressed.
Sealing the ends, tidying the hairline and advice for the first few days.

aftercare: Protect the braids at night with a bonnet or a satin pillowcase
Moisturise the scalp with a light oil, without weighing it down
Avoid keeping them in beyond the time advised at the consultation

faq.risposta: It depends on the type of work and on how fast your hair grows. The recommended time is given at the consultation, along with the right moment to redo them.

faq.domanda: Can I wash my hair with braids in?
faq.risposta: Yes, gently and with suitable products. At the consultation we explain how to do it without spoiling the work.

faq.domanda: Does the price change with length?
faq.risposta: The list price is CHF 90. For special work we agree a quote together before starting.

gel-costruttore-diamond-clear.descrizioneBreve: Clear, self-levelling builder gel for structured extensions.
gel-costruttore-diamond-clear.descrizione: A medium-thick builder that self-levels without running, perfect for building the apex and keeping the structure light. Its crystal clarity makes it ideal under any colour or nail art, and it does not yellow over time.
caratteristiche: Cures in 60 seconds in a LED lamp
Suitable for extensions up to 2 sizes

base-rubber-gold-touch.descrizioneBreve: Nude rubber base with a golden micro-shimmer, levelling and protective.
base-rubber-gold-touch.descrizione: An elastic base that evens out irregularities in the nail plate and protects the natural nail. The golden micro-shimmer makes it beautiful on its own, for a soft french or a sophisticated nude.
caratteristiche: Elastic, does not lift on flexible nails
Levels the nail without aggressive filing
Nude finish with a gold shimmer

top-coat-no-wipe-brillante.descrizioneBreve: Glossy sealer with no sticky layer and a mirror shine.
top-coat-no-wipe-brillante.descrizione: The top coat that finishes the work with a shop-window shine and needs no cleanser wipe. It resists scratches and keeps its gloss for the whole life of the set.

set-glitter-diamond.descrizioneBreve: Twelve ultra-fine glitters in gold, champagne and diamond shades.
set-glitter-diamond.descrizione: A coordinated palette of very fine glitters that spread evenly without clumping. Made for ombré fades, single-finger accents or full glitter coverage with a jewel effect.
caratteristiche: Works with gel and semi-permanent polish

gel-paint-linea-oro.descrizioneBreve: Dense, opaque gel paint for crisp lines and freehand decoration.
gel-paint-linea-oro.descrizione: A gel paint with a creamy texture that does not run and covers in a single pass. Perfect for fine lines, micro-details and crisp outlines, even with very thin liner brushes.
caratteristiche: Does not run: the line stays where you put it

pennello-gel-oval.descrizioneBreve: Oval synthetic-fibre brush for applying builder gel.
pennello-gel-oval.descrizione: The oval shape spreads the gel evenly and lets you shape the apex in just a few strokes. The synthetic fibre does not hold on to product and cleans in seconds.
caratteristiche: Lacquered wooden handle with gold ferrule

set-pennelli-nail-art.descrizioneBreve: Five decorating brushes: liner, one stroke, fan, detail and blending.
set-pennelli-nail-art.descrizione: The complete set to start with nail art without buying brushes one at a time. Each brush is made for a specific technique and comes in a hard case that protects them.
caratteristiche: 5 shapes: liner, one stroke, fan, detail, blending
Synthetic fibres, suitable for gel and acrylic

lampada-uv-led-72w-pro.descrizioneBreve: Professional dual-technology lamp with sensor and display.
lampada-uv-led-72w-pro.descrizione: Cures any gel or semi-permanent polish evenly thanks to the 36 LEDs set all around the dome. The motion sensor starts the cycle on its own and the display shows the time left.

fresa-professionale-35000.descrizioneBreve: Quiet, vibration-free handpiece with continuous speed control.
fresa-professionale-35000.descrizione: A light handpiece that stays cool even after hours of work and does not vibrate, so you have complete control over the filing. The rotation is reversible, for the same precision on both hands.

soft-gel-tips-almond.descrizioneBreve: Pre-shaped soft gel tips, 12 sizes, for express application.
soft-gel-tips-almond.descrizione: Very thin tips, already etched inside and ready to be glued with gel: the extension takes half the time of a traditional build and the result feels natural.
caratteristiche: Ultra-thin edge, invisible on the nail

dual-form-popit-12-forme.descrizioneBreve: Reusable forms with the apex already shaped, 296 pieces.
dual-form-popit-12-forme.descrizione: Dual forms with the curve and the apex already built in: fill, press on, cure and pop off. The structure comes out perfect even without years of freehand experience.

lime-zebra-100-180.descrizioneBreve: Double-grit files with a sturdy core, pack of ten.
lime-zebra-100-180.descrizione: The everyday file: 100 grit to shape the structure and 180 to refine the profile. The core does not bend and the coating holds up even on the hardest gel.
caratteristiche: Rigid core that does not warp

pinza-tronchesina-pro.descrizioneBreve: Tempered stainless steel, clean cut, fully sterilisable.
pinza-tronchesina-pro.descrizione: A hand-sharpened nipper that cuts the cuticle cleanly, without tearing. The tempered steel keeps its edge for a long time and withstands autoclave cycles without dulling.

olio-cuticole-argan-oro.descrizioneBreve: Fast-absorbing nourishing oil with golden micro-particles.
olio-cuticole-argan-oro.descrizione: A light oil that absorbs without leaving a greasy film and keeps the cuticle soft between appointments. The golden micro-particles leave a precious shimmer on the skin.

kit-pedicure-curativo.descrizioneBreve: Everything you need for professional foot treatment.
kit-pedicure-curativo.descrizione: A complete kit with foot file, degreaser, keratolytic cream and toe separators, made for treatment pedicures in the studio but also suitable for upkeep at home between appointments.
caratteristiche: Steel foot file with replacement heads

chiSiamo.sottotitolo: A studio that became a shop too, without ever stopping being a studio.

valori.testo: A correct structure lasts. A wrong one breaks, however beautiful the nail art on top.
We would rather have ten products we know than a thousand we have never opened.
Autoclave for everything that can be sterilised, single use for the rest. No exceptions.
The quote is agreed before we start. No surprises when it is time to pay.

spazio.testo: Two workstations, natural light and dedicated extraction on every table. We work by appointment so that every client gets the time their treatment needs.

paragrafi: K Institute started as a studio dedicated to nail care. Behind it is Kara, who learned the craft starting from the technique: structure, apex, hold. The aesthetics came afterwards.

Over the years the question clients — and then colleagues — asked most often was always the same: “what product do you use?”. That is where the shop came from: offering the very same products we use every day, with the same strict selection.
Today the studio and the shop feed each other. Every new product is tested for weeks at our workstations before it enters the catalogue. If it does not convince us, it never reaches the shelf.

privacy.sottotitolo: How we handle the personal data of people who use this site.

paragrafi: The data controller is {legalName} ({brand}), with registered offices at {sede}. For any request about your data, write to {email}.
We only collect the data you give us voluntarily: name, phone, email and notes when you book an appointment or fill in the contact form; plus the delivery address when you send an order request.
We use no profiling tools, we do not track browsing and we do not buy contact lists.
To handle the booking or the order request, to get back to you if needed, and to meet the tax and administrative obligations required by law.
For as long as it takes to provide the service requested and, where required, for the legal retention periods. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time.

You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction or portability of your data, and object to processing, by writing to {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

cookie.sottotitolo: Which cookies this site uses and what they are for.

paragrafi: This site uses only technical cookies and local storage needed for it to work: the contents of the cart and your acknowledgement of the cookie banner.
There are no profiling cookies, no advertising trackers and no third-party analytics.
The cart is saved in your browser (localStorage) under the key “k-institute-cart” and stays on your device: it is not sent to any server unless you voluntarily complete an order request.
The map on the contact page is embedded content from Google Maps: by loading it, Google may set its own cookies according to its own policy.
You can delete the data saved by the site at any time from your browser settings. If you disable local storage, the cart will no longer be kept between visits.
